notes:
Summary of evaluation and POC metrics:
- Business context: Mid-market analytics SaaS with in-app conversational assistant and a global doc search feature. High emphasis on sub-500ms tail latency for short chat replies; cost sensitivity for embedding-heavy workflows.
- Hosted trial configuration: default hosted_api plan keys provided; traffic generator replayed 2 weeks of production-like traffic (mix of chat + search + heavy rerank queries).
- Observed traffic mix: ~60% short chat (prompt ~40 tokens, completion ~60 tokens), 25% embedding-only (avg 512 tokens passed to encoder), 10% long summaries (prompt ~200 tokens, completion ~900 tokens), 5% reranking/batched requests.
- QPS & concurrency (hosted trial observed): steady-state QPS ~20-30, peak QPS bursts to 150 for short windows. Concurrent active sessions during peak ~120. Average token-per-request ~320 across all workloads; 95th percentile tokens dominated by long summaries.
- Latency: hosted 95p generation latency for 64-token completion ~380ms; long-summary completions 95p ~1.6s (acceptable). Embedding calls median ~45ms.
- Cost sensitivity: team expects < $0.025 per 1k prompt+completion tokens at scale; embeddings cost model critical (high volume).
- Desired Dedicated sizing: target baseline concurrency headroom 200 concurrent streams, steady QPS 50 with burst to 250 for 3-5 minute spikes. Need reserved GPU pool with autoscaling and burst credits.
- Routing/fallback: want policy to route low-latency chat to smaller, faster model variants and fallback to cheaper quantized model during non-critical windows.
- Security/compliance asks: VPC peering for Dedicated, customer KMS for key control, audit logging retention 1 year, data residency requirement for EU customers.
- POC takeaway: hosted trial validated correctness and initial perf. Primary blocker to move to Dedicated is procurement + exact burst pricing and residency SLAs. Customer requested a formal Dedicated capacity & cost proposal (incl. GPU types, anticipated token mix, and estimated monthly unit costs) by 2026-03-17.
- Direct quote from PM: "We like the latency profile on hosted but need firm numbers for reserved capacity — can't risk throttling during marketing-driven spikes."
- Next steps: detailed Dedicated sizing workshop w/ infra and finance (scheduled), draft SOW & pricing, coordinate legal/procurement timeline.
